% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpBox[data-page-navigation,data-allow-script]{
  Use the grouped buttons to change the current page.

  \wcTpButtonGroup[attached,aria-label=Page navigation]{
    \wcTpButton[data-previous,disabled]{Previous}
    \wcTpButton[data-next]{Next}
  }
  \wcP[data-page-status,role=status]{Page 1 of 5}
  \wcScript[src=/docs/components/button-group/examples/page-navigation.js]||
}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/box/box.js";
import "/components/button/button.js";
import "/components/button-group/button-group.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-box");
element1.setAttribute("data-page-navigation", "");
element1.setAttribute("data-allow-script", "");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element2 = document.createElement("p");
element2.append(document.createTextNode("Use the grouped buttons to change the current page."));
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element3 = document.createElement("tp-button-group");
element3.setAttribute("attached", "");
element3.setAttribute("aria-label", "Page navigation");
element3.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element4 = document.createElement("tp-button");
element4.setAttribute("data-previous", "");
element4.setAttribute("disabled", "");
element4.append(document.createTextNode("Previous"));
element3.append(element4);
element3.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element5 = document.createElement("tp-button");
element5.setAttribute("data-next", "");
element5.append(document.createTextNode("Next"));
element3.append(element5);
element3.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));
element1.append(element3);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element6 = document.createElement("p");
element6.setAttribute("data-page-status", "");
element6.setAttribute("role", "status");
element6.append(document.createTextNode("Page 1 of 5"));
element1.append(element6);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element7 = document.createElement("script");
element7.setAttribute("src", "/docs/components/button-group/examples/page-navigation.js");
element1.append(element7);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n"));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}
